title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — September 27, 2026

A new CME showed up in NASA’s DONKI, so Sunny is checking the Sun’s outer corona.

☀️ CME start: September 27, 2026 at 07:00 UTC
💨 CME speed: 606 km/s
🏷 CME SCORE: C-type (500–999 km/s)
📐 CME half-angle: 28° (Moderate)
📍 Source: S30W110 (beyond the western limb)
🌎 WSA-ENLIL Earth outlook: No or little Earth impact modeled

I'm watching the corona today.

Image: NOAA SWPC — CCOR-2
Data: NASA DONKI + NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
